name: SafeMailSkill
description: Safe, human-in-the-loop email management for Fastmail via JMAP. Provides shadow-delete and PIN-gated send capabilities so an AI agent never sends email without explicit human approval.

tools.name: delete_email
tools.description: Moves an email to the ai_trash folder instead of permanently deleting it. The email is recoverable and the action is fully auditable.

email_id.description: The JMAP Email ID of the message to shadow-delete.
The ID of the email that was moved to ai_trash.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Stages an outgoing email as a draft in the ai_outgoing folder and sends a PIN notification to the human owner. The email will NOT be sent until the human approves it with the correct PIN via the approve_send tool. Always use this instead of sending email directly.

tools.name: approve_send
tools.description: Approves and sends a staged email draft using a 4-digit PIN previously sent to the human via notification. The PIN expires after 1 hour. If the PIN is wrong or expired, the request is rejected.

pin.description: The 4-digit numeric PIN received via push notification.
